column3: ## Editorial Group Status for ManEds - Updating Editors
Setup: Use the editorial_group_status testdrive to set up for this test, OR follow the next step

Setup: To prepare to do this test manually, set up at least 2 editorial groups with multiple members and a good selection of applications assigned to a number of associate editors.  You should set yourself as the managing editor of those groups

Log in as the admin account supplied by the testdrive setup, then go to your ManEd Dashboard page (open it in a separate tab and leave the testdrive tab open, so the testdrive data is not torn down)

http://testdoaj.cottagelabs.com//dashboard
Select an editorial group to see its status information
Take a note of the number of applications assigned to one of your editors
Click on the count of applications next to the "unassigned" tag
Click "Review Application" on the application in the search interface
Assign the application to the editor selected above
Go back to the dashboard page (you may need to refresh it if you kept the page open)

column4: The editor selected now has one more application assigned to them
The number of unassigned applications has reduced by one

column3: Click on the count of applications next to the selected editor

column4: The application you assigned to the editor is listed in the search
